verdict.rationale: Devin's docs claim it can take Jira/Linear tickets or Slack threads and autonomously implement full features, which a PM could theoretically use to hand off a design task without engineering — but there is no evidence of any mockup/design-file ingestion (e.g., Figma) and independent benchmarking data ('13.8% of issues resolved') plus hands-on accounts of it produing shortcut/incorrect fixes ('wrapping code in a try-catch') and needing correction contradict the claim of full autonomous, handoff-free delivery. missing for 10: direct mockup/design-to-code ingestion capability, PM-specific workflow evidence, and independent success-rate data showing reliable end-to-end delivery without engineer review.
